mapper.select: SELECT e.id as eventId, es.id as eventScheduleId, e.thumbnail_url as thumbnailUrl, e.title, es.event_date as eventDate, v.venue_name as venueName, e.status FROM tb_event e LEFT JOIN tb_event_schedule es ON e.id = es.event_id LEFT JOIN tb_venue v ON es.venue_id = v.id WHERE e.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY es.event_date ASC

SELECT e.id as eventId, e.account_id as tenantId, e.title, e.age_limit as ageLimit, e.description, e.genre, e.thumbnail_url as thumbnailUrl, es.id as eventScheduleId, es.ticket_open_at as ticketOpenAt, es.event_date as eventDate, v.venue_name as venueName FROM tb_event e LEFT JOIN tb_event_schedule es ON e.id = es.event_id LEFT JOIN tb_venue v ON es.venue_id = v.id WHERE e.id = #{eventId} LIMIT 1
SELECT sc.class_name as className, p.price FROM tb_price p JOIN tb_seat_class sc ON p.seat_class_id = sc.id WHERE p.event_schedule_id = #{eventScheduleId} ORDER BY sc.priority ASC

SELECT sc.class_name as className, p.price FROM tb_price p JOIN tb_seat_class sc ON p.seat_class_id = sc.id JOIN tb_event_schedule es ON p.event_schedule_id = es.id WHERE es.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY sc.priority ASC
